Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Rug, 4' x 6', Blue, Ivory
Colors: Blue, Ivory
This beautiful hand-tufted blue and ivory rug will liven up your modern-style room. Spirited color and contemporary geometric patterns will make this a striking focal point for any room in need of a style boost. 4' x 6' Medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
